purpose: 실제 제품 사진을 바탕으로 배경과 조명을 연출한 메인 브랜드 이미지. 제품 규격 또는 시공 증빙용 이미지가 아님.
prompt:
Use case: compositing.
Asset type: premium Korean fire protection manufacturer's website hero campaign photograph, landscape 16:9, high resolution.
Primary request: Stage the TWO real DOENC products from the reference photographs as an iconic, premium industrial brand image. This is art direction of the supplied real products, not a product redesign.
Input image 1: exact product reference and compositing input — silver metal firestop jacket, circular cylindrical collar with folded radial silver rim tabs, dark black lining, short depth, small gold fastening details at bottom and small detached stack of silver L mounting brackets.
Input image 2: exact product reference and compositing input — thin white rectangular firestop board with ONE central circular hole and exactly TWO matching halves divided by a straight seam through the hole. Preserve its thin slab proportions and unadorned white mineral surface.
Scene/backdrop: seamless very dark navy studio, near #0b1728, a broad matte navy ground plane with a subtle pool of cool light under the products and real soft contact shadows. No horizon line, no objects except these real products and their own brackets.
Composition: refined wide editorial product photograph. Keep the LEFT 43% of the canvas completely quiet, very dark, empty for HTML headline overlay. Arrange the real products on the RIGHT 57%, occupying from x=48% to x=94%, y=18% to y=86%. The upright silver jacket is the dominant foreground subject on the right, viewed at almost exactly the original reference angle, enough to see the black inner circumference and folded rim tabs. Set the complete white board behind and to the jacket's left, at a low angle similar to its reference, both halves and split seam visible, with its central hole visible. A little overlap is fine. The objects are separate products, not an invented assembled system. Keep all edges and mounting brackets inside frame.
Lighting: sophisticated large softbox above left, restrained cool-blue rim light, realistic bright galvanized metal reflections, white board clean and tactile, deep but detailed black liner. Photorealistic material microtexture, measured contrast, high-end architectural engineering advertising. Products grounded naturally, no floating.
Constraints: faithfully preserve both real products' silhouettes, dimensions relative to their own structure, number of board halves, openings, construction, attachments, and surface materials. Do not invent additional fasteners, fins, ducts, pipes, bevels or hardware. Do not thicken the board. Small existing manufacturing markings may remain subtle; no invented legible printing or QR codes. No new words, no logo, no typography, no badge, no watermark. No flames, no sparks, no smoke, no glowing tech rings, no sci-fi appearance, no buildings, no underground utility tunnel. This will be labeled as an art-directed product image.
encoding: PNG 원본과 같은 1672 × 941 크기, WebP quality 90. 크롭·구도·제품 형태 수정 없음.
